about.heading: About
about.subtitle: Systems, evidence, and delivery
about.currentWorkDesc: Building e-commerce SaaS at Thoughtworks while developing agent evaluation, AI code review, and reusable AI delivery practices across teams.
about.bio1: I came to software through architecture and UX. That background trained me to read products as flows: where people hesitate, where state gets lost, and where a system quietly stops helping.
about.bio2: Today I work across frontend, BFF, and backend services. I treat agents as part of that delivery stack, with interfaces, APIs, data contracts, observability, and explicit failure paths.
about.bio3: My projects use frozen test sets, safety gates, human review, and cost measurements to make model behaviour inspectable.
about.bio4: I want to know what works, what fails, and whether the evidence supports the next delivery decision.
about.dir1Desc: Golden sets, safety gates, human review, and measurable ship decisions
